summary: Iteration 64: Verified categorized report cards feature. All backend APIs (report-types, report-card with type filter, PDF download) working correctly. Frontend 3-step flow (student list → folder view → report detail) fully functional with proper table formats for each report type.
passed_tests: GET /api/gradebook/report-types/{student_id} returns all 4 report types (end_of_term, mid_term, mocks, progressives)
Report types correctly shows has_data=true for progressives when student has progressive_test_1 data
Report types correctly shows has_data=true for end_of_term when student has end_of_term data
Report types correctly shows has_data=false for types without grades
GET /api/gradebook/report-card/{student_id}?report_type=progressives returns P1/P2/P3 format with averages
GET /api/gradebook/report-card/{student_id}?report_type=end_of_term returns CA/Exam/Final format
GET /api/gradebook/report-card/{student_id} without report_type returns full report
Report card includes student info (name, admission_number, class, year_group)
Report card includes summary (average, overall_grade, overall_remark, attendance)
PDF download for progressives report returns valid PDF with correct filename
PDF download for end_of_term report returns valid PDF with correct filename
PDF download for full report (no type) returns valid PDF
GET /api/academic/classes returns list of classes
GET /api/admin/students?class_id={class_id} returns students in class
GET /api/gradebook/entries returns grades for student
Report types for non-existent student returns empty types (all has_data=false)
Report card for non-existent student returns 404
Report card for type with no data returns empty grades array
Report Cards page loads with class selector and term selector
Selecting Year 7 class shows 16 students with grade counts and averages
Clicking student opens folder view with 4 report type folders plus Full Academic Report option
Progressives folder shows 'Available' badge when data exists
Mocks folder shows 'No data yet' when empty
Clicking Progressives folder opens report with P1/P2/P3 columns
Breadcrumb navigation works (Students > Student Name > Folder Type)
Back to Folders button works correctly
Back to Students button works correctly
Search filter works on student list (filtered to 1 result for 'Ayeyi')
Full Academic Report View button works
Full report shows CA/Exam/Final format
Download PDF button visible and functional
End of Term folder shows 'Available' badge for student with end_of_term data
End of Term report shows CA/30, Exam/70, Final % columns correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Backend gradebook.py: Well-structured REPORT_TYPES definition with score_types mapping
Backend report-types endpoint correctly aggregates score_types to determine data availability
Backend report_card_data properly formats grades based on report_type (progressives vs mid_term/mocks vs end_of_term/full)
Backend PDF generation adapts table columns based on report_type
Frontend ReportCardsPage.jsx: Clean 3-step flow with proper state management
Frontend folder view uses FOLDER_CONFIG for consistent styling and icons
Frontend properly shows 'Available' badge when has_data=true, 'No data yet' when false
Frontend breadcrumb navigation implemented with data-testid attributes for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 64 verified the categorized report cards feature. Key test data: user_cc6f5faa1522 (Ayeyi Forson, Year 7) has progressive_test_1 data in Term 2, user_fee95a806d25 (Dannii McCaesar, Year 13) has end_of_term data in Term 2. Report types: end_of_term (CA/Exam/Final format), mid_term/mocks (Score/100 format), progressives (P1/P2/P3 format). All 4 folder types display correctly with Available/No data badges. PDF download works for all report types.
